PUBLISHED ON 10/14/2026


Visit Tenaris at Stand 1A-30, Hall 1 at the Patagonia Oil and Gas 2026 in Neuquén, Argentina.


Tenaris


The energy sector gathers once again at Patagonia Oil & Gas 2026, one of the leading oil and gas events in Latin America, taking place in Neuquén, Argentina. Tenaris will be present alongside Tecpetrol, Techint Engineering & Construction and Ternium – sister companies of the Techint Group- from October 19-22 at Espacio DUAM.


The stand will be located in the central pavilion (Stand 1A-30, Hall 1), highlighting some of the Group's most significant energy projects driving the sector's development.


**Andrea Previtali** , President of Tenaris for the Southern Cone, will also participate in the CEOs Panel on Wednesday, October 21 at 5:30 PM in the Main Auditorium (Sala Tromen), alongside representatives from SLB, Halliburton and Calfrac.


Tenaris will also deliver three technical presentations led by members of its commercial and technical teams:


**Monday, Oct 19 | 3:30 – 4:00 PM | Sala Lanin 1**


Constantino Espinosa, Project Director at Tenaris Oil & Gas Services, will present Tenaris's new integrated solution for surface casing construction in Vaca Muerta. A turnkey solution featuring the operation of a one-of-a-kind drilling rig in Argentina.


**Wednesday, Oct 21 | 3:00 – 3:30 PM | Sala Lanin 2**


Luciano Mettifogo and Luciano Grosso, Senior Managers from Tenaris's commercial team, will present TenLock®, a mechanical interference-based connection solution for line pipe that offers a faster, safer, and more efficient alternative to traditional systems.


**Thursday, Oct 22 | 2:30 – 3:00 PM | Sala Lanin 3**


Andrés Alam, Technical Sales Manager for Sucker Rods, will present TenFlow XF™, Tenaris's advanced hydrodynamic sucker rod centralizer featuring high-performance polymer technology to optimize downhole operations.


The Patagonia Oil & gas runs October 19–22, from 1:00 to 8:00 PM at Espacio DUAM, Neuquén.[Register here](https://aogpatagonia.com.ar/acreditaciones/) .
